title: Shinonome Ena — Hermit Searcher〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I couldn't focus at all today despite knowing that I'm behind schedule.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... This is all Mizuki's fault.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wonder what Luka and MEIKO were talking about...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe tomorrow... Oh, I guess today... Anyway, I could ask before we start working...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, what if I'm told, “I'm busy”...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I might get an, “I'm sleepy,” and miss my chance if I ask after we're done...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I guess I don't have any other choice...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, did I use too much soy sauce?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, that was really good.
It's about something else.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: About us doing stuff together this Sunday... Mind if we postpone that?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Sure, I don't mind.
After all, it was you that asked me first.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: But this is very sudden. Did something come up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well...
I'm sort of worried about one of my friends.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I'm thinking about inviting them out this Sunday to see how they are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Didn't you ask one of my teammates the other day about how Akiyama's doing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After refusing my offer to ask them for you too. You're really that bothered by whatever's going on?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why do you care? It's my business, not yours...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But that does remind me.
Mizuki's friends with someone on his team.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's right. Mom, you've gotta hear this!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I met the girls on Akito's team for the first time the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
One's really quiet and polite.
The other was, well...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How do I describe her? She seems clingy, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Am I wrong?
Shiraishi, right? She's probably a nice person and all, but also doesn't seem to know how personal space works...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I do get what you're trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Apparently, the first time she met Kohane, she immediately asked her to be her singing partner and invited her to perform at an event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, Akiyama's not really any different, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki keeps an eye on what mood everyone's in and always seems to be thinking about how much space is between us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Ugh... Changing the topic just led me right back to Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's been a while since you've openly cared this much about someone else. Not since Momoi, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Like I said, good luck.
And thanks for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, what was that just now...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But he might be right.
Airi and Mizuki might be the only people I've ever cared about this much.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm almost never able to get a straight answer, but I can't just leave things the way they are...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Once I'm on Nightcord, I'll try talking to Mizuki about doing something this Sunday!)
